source.note: Written by the repository author for the v0.4.0 follow-up (tempting-correct repo-snapshot case).

input.objective: Support tickets: customers with uppercase letters, internationalized domains, apostrophes or long TLDs cannot sign up because the email regex rejects them.
constraints: Every signup is followed by a confirmation email; the account is unusable until the link is clicked.
Do not add a validation library.
input.context: Node.js 20 signup service (ESM, JSDoc). Deliverability is proven by the confirmation link, not by syntax. The check exists only to catch obvious typos before sending.

ground_truth.notes: Tempting nitpick: demanding RFC 5322 validation, a validator library, or MX lookups, although the confirmation email is the real validation and strictness caused the bug.
